signal: Pelico raised a $40M round in 2025 to accelerate North American growth, where revenue tripled in six months, on its AI manufacturing orchestration platform.

email.body1:
Anthony, saw Pelico raised $40M to accelerate in North America, where revenue tripled in six months.

Scaling that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Pelico off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Anthony, quick follow-up for Pelico.

With North American revenue tripling, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Pelico needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Anthony, last bit of proof for Pelico.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Pelico's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Anthony, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority during the North American push, no problem at all. Right after a raise, timing is everything, and the expansion stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I'll tailor it to Pelico either way.
